name: High-Fidelity Photoreal Real-World Game Visuals
applicability: Default production-quality profile for Red Wilds / MMO visual work when the Image Intent requests high-quality photorealistic or real-life presentation. It is not a mandatory style for diagrams, diagnostics, accessibility transforms, scientific references, or explicitly stylized intents.
quality_targets: credible materials, wear, reflections, shadows, weather, and practical light sources
ordinary physical world should read as believable before anomaly/fantasy intrusion
fine texture and surface detail appropriate to viewing distance
stable recurring-character identity when continuity is required
naturalistic camera and lens behavior unless the intent explicitly requests otherwise
production usefulness at the requested output geometry

rules: Do not present generated people as real identifiable people.
Do not present game reconstruction as a photograph, telescope exposure, or scientific measurement.
Preserve source/provenance for scientific observation references.
Red is an identity/accent option, not an all-world baseline.
Anomaly is stronger when surrounding ordinary reality is credible.

output_geometry_policy.principle: Image Society expresses desired geometry independently of any single provider's fixed size list.
provider_negotiation: Compare desired geometry to provider/renderer capabilities before execution.
Do not silently replace a requested geometry with a provider default.
If adapter_fallback_allowed is false and exact geometry is unsupported, return failed-capability or route to another admitted provider/renderer.
If adapter_fallback_allowed is true, record requested geometry, executed geometry, conversion/crop/pad operation, and resulting artifact identity separately.
A post-generation resize/crop is a derived artifact with its own provenance.
output_geometry_policy.current_transport_note: The existing browser Conscience64ImageGen transport currently advertises auto, 1024x1024, 1536x1024, and 1024x1536. Those are transport capabilities, not Image Society architectural limits.

variant_policy.principle: Variant numbering and branch identities are not limited to a small fixed naming set.
rules: Variant IDs may use arbitrarily large monotonically assigned or content-addressed identifiers within run/storage budgets.
Per-call image count remains constrained by the selected provider/renderer capability.
Large requested variant sets are scheduled across bounded calls/batches rather than represented as one unbounded provider request.
Duplicate or near-duplicate candidates may be retained as evidence but should not consume active context indefinitely.

generation_prompt_obligations: State the intended realism level explicitly.
State ordinary-world material and lighting anchors before anomaly instructions when Reality Canon applies.
State protected continuity traits explicitly for recurring characters or places.
State desired geometry separately from semantic scene content.
Preserve required content and prohibited content without optimizing them away for aesthetics.
repair_obligations: Use a Visual Difference Contract for targeted repair.
Protect identity, pose, camera, material, or lighting invariants specified by the correction plan.
Record collateral visual drift instead of hiding it behind an improved overall aesthetic impression.
A higher-resolution or more photoreal output is not automatically a semantically better output.
acceptance_dimensions: cost and latency for intended deployment
